schemes.crossSchemeRelationship: Krishi-DSS is a core Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) pillar under the ₹2,817 Cr Digital Agriculture Mission umbrella.
schemes.examTrapVerified: Confirmed: Krishi-DSS is an umbrella DPI component under Digital Agriculture Mission, not a private tech vendor tool.

schemes.schemeTitle: SHREYAS Scheme (Scholarships for Higher Education for Young Achievers Scheme)
schemes.crossSchemeRelationship: SHREYAS umbrella subsumes Top Class SC, Free Coaching SC/OBC, NOS for SC, and National Fellowship for SC. (NF-OBC is parallelly administered under OBC Welfare).
schemes.examTrapVerified: Confirmed: SHREYAS (Higher education scholarships/fellowships) is distinct from SHRESHTA (CBSE residential schools for SC students).

schemes.schemeTitle: PM YASASVI (PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India)
schemes.crossSchemeRelationship: Consolidates 5 sub-components: Pre-Matric, Post-Matric, Top Class School, Top Class College, and Hostels.
schemes.examTrapVerified: Confirmed: Selection for Top Class School Education uses merit lists from National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

schemes.schemeTitle: National Overseas Scholarship (NOS) for SC, DNT, and Landless Labourers
schemes.crossSchemeRelationship: Operates as a flagship central sector overseas study scholarship administered under Social Justice framework.
schemes.examTrapVerified: Confirmed: 125 annual slots total; strictly requires Top 500 QS ranking; 30% women quota.

schemes.schemeTitle: SMILE Scheme (Support for Marginalised Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise)
schemes.crossSchemeRelationship: SMILE contains 2 distinct sub-schemes: Transgender Persons Welfare (₹265 Cr) + Begging Rehabilitation (₹100 Cr).
schemes.examTrapVerified: Confirmed: Encompasses both Transgender welfare and Begging rehabilitation; includes Garima Greh shelter homes.

schemes.schemeTitle: Dr. Ambedkar Central Sector Scheme of Interest Subvention on Overseas Educational Loans for OBCs and EBCs
schemes.crossSchemeRelationship: Central sector interest subvention linked with IBA Model Educational Loan scheme and administered via Canara Bank.
schemes.examTrapVerified: Confirmed: Nodal Bank is Canara Bank; covers interest during moratorium only; principal repaid by borrower.

schemes.schemeTitle: Solar Power Scheme for PVTGs (under PM-JANMAN)
schemes.crossSchemeRelationship: The Solar Power Scheme for PVTGs is MNRE's dedicated component under the broader multi-ministry PM-JANMAN mission.
schemes.examTrapVerified: Confirmed: Nodal ministry is MNRE; individual systems are 0.3 kW; MPC systems are 2.5 kW.

schemes.crossSchemeRelationship: Specialized central sector fellowship under MoSJE OBC Welfare portfolio.
schemes.examTrapVerified: Confirmed: 1,000 annual slots (not 300); updated to ₹37k/₹42k rates.

schemes.schemeTitle: SEED Scheme (Scheme for Economic Empowerment of DNT/NT/SNT Communities)
schemes.crossSchemeRelationship: Dedicated flagship scheme executed by DWBDNC Board under MoSJE.
schemes.examTrapVerified: Confirmed: Nodal agency is DWBDNC; covers 4 specific pillars (Coaching, PM-JAY health, Livelihoods, Housing).

schemes.schemeTitle: National Action Plan for Drug Demand Reduction (NAPDDR) & Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan
schemes.crossSchemeRelationship: NAPDDR is the umbrella centrally sponsored action plan under which NMBA operates as the mass community campaign.
schemes.examTrapVerified: Confirmed: NMBA launched on 15 Aug 2020; helpline is 14446; expanded from 272 to all districts.
